name: signed_jump_neg_5d
description: 5-day rolling mean of intraday signed_jump (rv_pos - rv_neg)/rv, sign-flipped so that high factor value corresponds to long positions. Source column signed_jump comes from the joined prices+intraday dataset built by scripts/etl/build_prices_with_intraday.py. Sanity-IC over 2016-2025 vs next-day return: IC=-0.032, t=-13.3 (highly significant negative), so after sign flip the factor is expected to have positive long-side IC.
unavailable_data_policy: When signed_jump is NaN (rv_5m below epsilon, or pre-listing / panel-missing rows broadcast NaN through intraday_features), the rolling mean stays NaN and the row is naturally dropped from cross-sectional ranking. No imputation.
pit_assumption: signed_jump is computed strictly from same-day 09:30-15:00 minute bars; 5-day rolling mean uses days t-4..t inclusive. The factor value at date t is available at t close (15:00 local). Standard pipeline shift to next-day open is the responsibility of the case YAML target horizon, not this builder.

def build_factor(frame):
    """Negated 5-day rolling mean of intraday signed_jump.

    Hypothesis: a positive signed_jump (rv_pos > rv_neg) reflects upside
    overshoot / asymmetric jump risk that mean-reverts within a few days.
    The factor flips the sign so high values correspond to "long" candidates.

    Inputs (from joined prices+intraday dataset):
      - date (str), asset (str)
      - signed_jump (float in [-1, 1])
    Notes:
      - Rolling per asset, min_periods=3 to allow factor to start within ~3
        sessions of the universe inclusion date.
      - Returns canonical 4-col long form (date, asset, factor, value);
        the factor_recipe wrapper consumes (date, asset, value) and tags
        factor name from the recipe.
    """

    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    window = 5
    min_periods = 3

    df = frame[["date", "asset", "signed_jump"]].copy()
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="coerce")
    df = (
        df.dropna(subset=["date", "asset"])
        .sort_values(["asset", "date"], kind="mergesort")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    rolled = (
        df.groupby("asset", sort=False)["signed_jump"]
        .rolling(window=window, min_periods=min_periods)
        .mean()
        .reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    )
    df["value"] = -pd.to_numeric(rolled, errors="coerce").replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
    )
    df["date"] = df["date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    return df[["date", "asset", "value"]]
